enabled.title: Allow processing
enabled.description: This switch alone does not start collection. CONFIG.enabled and PIPELINE_LIVE_ENABLED must also be true, and approved budget must remain. The Output report explains every disabled gate and the saved lead counts. Default: status only, no search or validation.

stateStoreId.title: Pipeline state store
stateStoreId.description: Must match COT_CLOUD_STORE_ID. Grants access only to the selected pipeline storage.

lockQueueId.title: Pipeline lock queue
lockQueueId.description: Must match COT_CLOUD_LOCK_QUEUE_ID. Use a dedicated queue.
